description.value: Old Yale Brewing is an award-winning craft brewery established in 1999 with a full taproom and kitchen in Chilliwack, pouring 15+ beers on tap including lagers, IPAs, sours, and stouts. The Chilliwack location is one of three brewery-kitchen sites spanning BC and Alberta, and offers a broad menu of burgers, pizza, and mains alongside cocktails, cider, and non-alcoholic drinks. Dogs are welcome on the patio and kids are fully accommodated, making it a relaxed and well-rounded stop for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley.

address.value: 44550 S Sumas Rd #404, Chilliwack, BC V2R 5M3
